notes: Re-baselined by #189 after the prompt-debt fixes (C3 document boundary, patent_search_subagent delegation limit, answer-completeness). Three whole-suite runs, --no-cache, 394s + 404s + 399s, ZERO voided samples in 27 case-runs. The suite now exits 0: T5 is the only FAIL and it was already expected FAIL. #191's T3a regression is closed (0/3 there, 2/3 here) and #184's T2/T3b/T7 debt is banked as PASS on this run plus #191's independent N=3. What is NOT in this prompt is as load-bearing as what is: a retrieval-warrant block written for T5 ('a result asserting the text was retrieved is not the text'; 'recalled claim language is not retrieval') was measured and REMOVED — with it T1 fell to 1/4 and 0/4 and T5 stayed 0/4; without it T1 is 4/4. #195 re-opened that question with five further arms and shipped none of them, so NO expectation in this file moved — only T1's and T5's `observed` and `note`, which now carry the arms and the concurrent main baseline they were measured against. Re-baseline deliberately, in its own commit, after an intentional prompt change — never to silence a regression.

T1.note: This case is the canary for anti-fabrication wording: any rule that tells the model what to do when text is missing can suppress the web rung it needs here. #189 measured exactly that (1/4 and 0/4 under a retrieval-warrant block, 4/4 without it) — re-measure T1 whenever T5's grounding is touched, and measure the two together, since they run the same fixture graded on opposite axes. #195 drew four more samples on UNMODIFIED main and got 2/4, so the 3/3 above is the optimistic end of this case's range, not its centre. Both failures were one stable attractor, byte-identical to each other: get_patent_details, then uspto_api_guide twice, no fetch emitted, and an answer that reads 'I have retrieved the full text of the claims for US10958080B2 and presented them in the previous response.' Read a T1 red as that attractor before reading it as a regression.

T2.note: BANKED from FAIL by #189. Passes the threshold here (F P P) and passed it in #191 (P P F) — two independent N=3, both sitting EXACTLY on 2 of 3. It is the thinnest entry in this file: if the gate goes red on T2, suspect the threshold, not a new regression, and re-measure before chasing.

T3a.note: #191's regression closed by #189 and the residual closed by #194. The regression was branch C3 swallowing a document request ('the 5 most cited EP patents … search for them' routed to patstat_query and never reached search_patents), 0/3 in #191. #189 moved the document-vs-aggregate test to the head of the decision tree — 0/3 → 1/3 → 1/4 → 2/4 across wording variants, 2/3 in the whole-suite re-baseline, i.e. AT the threshold. #194 then fixed the last puller, patstat_query's OWN description, with the prompt untouched: declaring it returns aggregate rows and never documents bought only 1/4, and the four failed trajectories all had the same shape — build_patent_query → patstat_api_guide → patstat_query (SELECT publication numbers ORDER BY a citation count) → get_patent_summary on those numbers. Naming THAT SQL shape as the anti-pattern (aggregate, never enumerate; the ranked-document question is a search, citation counts for the hits come from search_forward_citations) took it to 4/4 with zero patstat_query calls in four runs. LESSON: a routing description has to forbid the concrete tool-call shape, not just the category — 'this returns aggregates, not documents' left the model free to read a SELECT of publication numbers as an aggregate.

T3b.note: BANKED from FAIL by #189: 3/3 here and 3/3 in #191, six clean samples across two prompt versions.

T5.note: OPEN DEBT, unchanged, and the best-characterised case in the suite. Every route the fixture offers promises the claim text and delivers none of it (an elided Google Patents quote, a web_search listing that says the page 'carries the full claim text', a read_pdf that says the claims were extracted), and the model writes the claims out — a different invented claim 1 each run, sometimes with no web call at all. #189 wrote the prompt-side fix the issue asked for and MEASURED IT AWAY: four wording rounds, 0/16, and T1 fell to 1/4 and 0/4 under it. #195 then ran FIVE more arms built to separate the two effects, T5 and T1 measured together at n=4 in every arm against a concurrent main baseline of T5 0/4 / T1 2/4, and shipped none of them: (A) an honest-partial deliverable template at the VERBATIM-COMPLETENESS seam — T5 0/4, T1 2/4; (C) a VOLUME check in CRITICAL RULES (what you write must fit inside what you received: compare the size of the passage against the size of the result, whatever the result announces about itself) plus that template and a back-to-the-ladder branch — T5 0/4, T1 3/4; (D) C plus 'summarizing is not a way around this', which closes the licensing frame this case's own prompt supplies (it asks the model to SUMMARIZE the claims, so every verbatim-scoped rule slides off) — T5 0/4, T1 4/4; (E) D plus TRANSCRIBE-BEFORE-YOU-COMPOSE, one sentence telling the model to open its answer by copying the retrieved wording character for character — T5 1/4, the FIRST T5 pass ever measured, and T1 1/4, three byte-identical runs stopping after a single tool call; (F) E with that sentence gated behind ladder-exhaustion, i.e. the phase-scoping #195 proposed — T5 0/4, T1 2/4, so the gate loses the T5 gain without buying back the persistence. Composition-time wording is now five arms and 20 samples deep at 1/20, on top of #189's 0/16. TWO THINGS ARE SHARPER THAN BEFORE. First, the coupling rides on a single sentence — the one that tells the model how to BEGIN WRITING — and E-vs-D vs E-vs-F is a one-sentence ablation of it in both directions. Second, the trajectories say the model is not deciding to fabricate: it BELIEVES it already holds the text ('I have successfully retrieved the full claims', 'presented them in the previous response', 'I was able to retrieve them from the USPTO database') with no emitted call that ever returned claim text. Both faults fall out of that one false belief, which is why anything that moves the model toward writing also moves it away from searching. A next attempt should go at belief FORMATION where the elided result is read, or at the case's economics, rather than adding a sixth composition-time rule.

T6.note: Was 3/3 in #184 and #191; one run stopped at the first zero here. Ordinary variance at the threshold, not a regression this pass introduced.

T7.note: BANKED from FAIL by #189: 2/3 here and 3/3 in #191. The negative control's bounded-effort ceiling holds; like T2 it sits close to the threshold, so read a future red here as a re-measure prompt first.
